Log Cluster-Robust e-Value for a Joint Wald Test

Source: R/cluster_robust.R
log_E_CR.Rd

The cluster-robust e-process of Lindon (2026), eq. (ECR), with \(\nu = G - 1\) and exponent \(G/2\) for any number \(q\) of tested coefficients: $$E_G = \left(\frac{g}{g+G}\right)^{q/2} \left(\frac{1 + Q/(G-1)}{1 + \frac{g}{g+G} Q/(G-1)}\right)^{G/2}.$$

Usage

log_E_CR(Q, q, G, g)

Arguments

Q

The cluster-robust Wald statistic.

q

The number of tested coefficients.

G

The number of clusters.

g

The precision parameter, on the cluster scale.

Value

The log e-value.

References

Lindon, M. (2026). Anytime-Valid Inference in Linear Models with Clustered Outcomes: Exact Multivariate Tests and Cluster-Robust Confidence Sequences. arXiv:2610.25613. https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25613
